summary: The November 11 research verified the October 30 short-interest cycle: secondary FINRA/NYSE transcriptions report 42,393,750 shares short, down 11.74%, while the official NYSE file and FINRA calendar confirm the reporting cycle. SEC EDGAR and GameStop investor relations showed no issuer disclosure after October 19. Contract-complete market/options evidence and defensible live borrow evidence remain unavailable, so confidence stays Low.
